SELECT f[OFFSET(0)] AS f0, ML.MULTI_HOT_ENCODER(f, 3, 1) OVER () AS output
FROM
  (
    SELECT ['a', 'b', 'b', 'c', NULL] AS f
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ['c', 'c', 'd', 'd', NULL] AS f
  )
ORDER BY f[OFFSET(0)]
